annotations.exact_quote: A multiscale superpixel segmentation is first used to model the distribution of classes based on spatial information.

annotations.exact_quote: Then, a subspace-based support vector machine (SVMsub) is adopted to obtain the classification maps with multiscale inputs. Finally, the classification result is achieved via a decision fusion process.
